description: AMM pool reserves and trading fee for an asset pair. When to use: To read AMM pool depth and fee for a pair. Prefer another tool: It does not estimate slippage or compare venues (use the slippage page for the CLOB vs AMM comparison); a pair without a pool returns 404. Example: xrpl_amm {"a":"XRP","b":"4555524F50000000000000000000000000000000.rMkEuRii9w9uBMQDnWV5AA43gvYZR9JxVK"}

a.description: First asset: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

b.description: Second asset: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

name: xrpl_amm

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

a_frozen.description: True when asset_a is frozen, so the pool cannot be traded

a_per_lp_token.description: reserve_a / supply: units of asset_a per LP token; null for an empty pool

asset_a_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `asset_a`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

asset_b_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `asset_b`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

account.description: Holder of the slot, who trades at the discounted fee (amm_info auction_slot.account, the slot's Account)

auth_accounts.description: Up to 4 further accounts that trade at the discounted fee (amm_info auction_slot.auth_accounts, the slot's AuthAccounts); empty when none

discounted_fee_pct.description: Fee the holder trades at, a decimal string in percent: DiscountedFee / 1000, exact

expires_at.description: When the slot expires (amm_info auction_slot.expiration, the slot's Expiration), RFC 3339 with milliseconds

outbid_price.description: LP tokens to outbid the holder now, by rippled AMMBid.cpp L313-327 at the served `time_interval`: price × 1.05 + `auction_slot_minimum_price` in interval 0, price × 1.05 × (1 − ((interval + 1) / 20)^60) + `auction_slot_minimum_price` after it, `auction_slot_minimum_price` once expired (interval 20); rounded half-up to at most 18 places, while rippled computes it in `Number` (16-digit mantissa), so the last digits can differ; null when the interval is unknown

price.description: What the holder paid for the slot, in LP tokens (amm_info auction_slot.price, the slot's Price), exact

time_interval.description: Current 1/20 interval of the 24-hour slot, 0 to 19, or 20 once expired, as amm_info reports it (auction_slot.time_interval, which rippled computes from the parent ledger close time); null when the node omits it

auction_slot.description: Auction slot: active while unexpired at the read ledger, discounted fee in percent (DiscountedFee / 1000, exact), expiry time; null when no account holds the slot

auction_slot_minimum_price.description: LP tokens to take a vacant or expired slot: LPTokenBalance × TradingFee / 100000 / 25, rounded half-up to at most 18 places

b_frozen.description: True when asset_b is frozen, so the pool cannot be traded

b_per_lp_token.description: reserve_b / supply: units of asset_b per LP token; null for an empty pool

lp_token.description: LP token of the pool: currency code, issuer (the AMM account) and outstanding supply

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of the LP token's 40-hex code; null when not printable ASCII (an AMM LP code starts with 0x03, so null)

supply.description: Outstanding LP tokens (LPTokenBalance), a decimal string in LP tokens

reserve_a.description: Pool reserve of `asset_a`, a decimal string in units of `asset_a` (XRP in XRP, not drops)

reserve_b.description: Pool reserve of `asset_b`, a decimal string in units of `asset_b` (XRP in XRP, not drops)

spot_a_per_b.description: Fee-free pool price of one b in a: reserve_a / reserve_b; null for an empty pool

spot_a_per_b_with_fee.description: Marginal price of one b in a including the trading fee: spot_a_per_b / (1 - trading_fee_pct / 100); null for an empty pool

spot_b_per_a.description: Fee-free pool price of one a in b: reserve_b / reserve_a; null for an empty pool

spot_b_per_a_with_fee.description: Marginal price of one a in b including the trading fee: spot_b_per_a / (1 - trading_fee_pct / 100); null for an empty pool

trading_fee_pct.description: Pool trading fee in percent: TradingFee / 1000, exact

max_fee_pct.description: Highest voted fee, a decimal string in percent: TradingFee / 1000, exact

min_fee_pct.description: Lowest voted fee, a decimal string in percent: TradingFee / 1000, exact

weighted_sd_pct.description: VoteWeight-weighted standard deviation of the voted fees, a decimal string in percent; null when the weights sum to zero

vote_dispersion.description: Trading-fee votes: count, lowest and highest voted fee in percent (exact), and the vote-weighted standard deviation of the voted fees in percent, rounded once to 18 places (null when the weights sum to zero); null without votes

vote_slots.description: The pool's trading-fee votes, in the order amm_info lists them: voting account, voted fee in percent (TradingFee / 1000, exact) and vote weight as a ratio (VoteWeight / 100000, exact); empty without votes

account.description: Account that cast this vote, an LP holder (its vote slot's Account)

trading_fee_pct.description: Fee this account voted for, a decimal string in percent: its vote slot's TradingFee / 1000, exact

vote_weight_ratio.description: Weight of this vote as a fraction of the LP token balance, a decimal string: its vote slot's VoteWeight / 100000, exact
